data.description: 甜点部更衣室里，换装发生意外的和纱身上只套着一件雪白的烘焙围裙，光洁无暇的肩头与修长双腿毫无防备地暴露在外。她慌乱地按紧围裙下摆，头顶猫耳紧紧贴在发间，粉瞳水汪汪地泛着羞愤红晕——「老、老师？！为什么不敲门就进来了……！不许看……呜，绝对不准当成甜点一样盯着我看啦……！」
data.promptProse: Adult Kazusa presses both hands over the lower edge of her white baking apron after the changing-room mishap, turning toward the unexpected off-frame visitor with a flustered expression. The warm changing-room lamp keeps her face and hands clear.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 甜点部更衣室·裸身围裙的害羞契约
data.animaCaption: Both hands secure the apron edge as she turns toward the unexpected visitor.
